name: press_button
text: A person stands facing a vending machine and reaches the right hand forward to press one button at chest height on the right side, pauses briefly at the button, then withdraws the hand to the side. Keep feet planted. One deliberate reach, press, and retract.

review.reason: 伸右手按键后收回；仅3帧全身约束，接触阶段手部局部约束；按键目标最大误差1.4厘米。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
